# Jory Petrakis

Delivery and facilities lead for the network since 2023, based at the Millbrook branch. Jory runs the two network vans, schedules the part-time drivers, and supervises the sorting room.

Jory drafted the [[Thistle Run|courier consolidation]] proposal after tracking a year of late holds caused by handoffs between Ridgeway and the county van. Questions about stop times, missing bins, or items damaged in transit go to Jory first.

Jory also keeps the [[Van maintenance log]] and trains new drivers on lifting and loading.
